definitions.full: H7407. rokes [ רֹ֫כֶס ] noun [masculine] dubious, Thes Hup-Now snare , or band (Dr banding together ), or (most) league, conspiracy (RV plottings ); Ol reads derivatives of רכל = slander , so ( רְכִילֵי ) Che Du; Bae despairs; — plural construct רֻכְסֵיאִֿישׁ Psa 31:21 (|| לְשֹׁנוֺת דִיב ).
